hero.title: A Twist on Mobility
hero.subtitle: A Rubik's Cube-inspired spherical guide robot, <br class='block md:hidden' />made to move seamlessly from indoors and out.

item0.title: Rubik's Cube Mechanism
item0.desc:
A spherical form factor freely rotating 360 degrees
agilely changes direction while navigating the campus.

item1.title: Seamless Wheel Transform
item1.desc:
Detects road conditions and physically rotates
to switch between smooth indoor and rugged outdoor wheels.

voice.title: Voice-based Conversation
voice.desc: Detects the user's call phrase to initiate interaction, converts speech to text (STT), and delivers responses as speech (TTS) based on LLM. Users can request wayfinding and information without complex operations.

gesture.title: Gesture-based Interaction
gesture.desc: Recognizes gestures such as waving, pointing with fingers, stopping, and thumbs up. Particularly, waving can be used as a signal to initiate conversation alongside voice commands, making it easy to get the robot's attention even in situations where voice use is difficult.
